# `curb_xml_format`

Format project, props, targets, solution and nuget.config files. false leaves them unread.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

On by default. To turn XML formatting off for a whole repository, add a section for the files to the root `.editorconfig`:

```ini
[*.{csproj,fsproj,vbproj,proj,props,targets,slnx,config}]
curb_xml_format = false
```

### `curb_xml_format = true`

```ini
curb_xml_format = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
        <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
    </PropertyGroup>



  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A"/>
    <PackageReference   Include="B"   Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A"/>
    <PackageReference Include="B" Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

::::
